title: Arkret Federated Device Signing Key Evidence
description: Portable device-key authorization evidence. The original accepted service-attested ak.device.authorize Event cryptographically binds the key to the principal's DID-designated enrollment authority; the authenticated source Principal Server attests only that the authorization is current and active. Transport-only: this object never enters another Event digest, Realm reducer, Seal, or timeline.

device_signing_key.description: Ed25519 device signing public key. The multibase suffix MUST equal device_authorize_event.payload.device_public_key.

authorization_accepted_at.description: Source authority's server-sealed acceptance time for device_authorize_event. The destination uses this time for historical DID/enrollment-authority resolution; it MUST be no earlier than the Event created_at and no later than the source service attestation time.

device_authorize_event.description: Original accepted ak.device.authorize Event. It MUST target actor_id/device_id, carry enrollment_authority_binding.kind=service_attested, bind device_signing_key, and have portable proofs with no service-specific domain or audience. The destination independently verifies its proof against the DID-designated enrollment authority.
